critical-message.name: Default Critical Message
critical-message.hint: The text displayed during a critical hit animation (fallback if no actor quote).

fumble-message.name: Default Fumble Message
fumble-message.hint: The text displayed during a natural 1 fumble animation.

animation-style.name: Animation Style
animation-style.hint: Choose your personal visual style for the animation overlay.

global-animation-style.name: Global Animation Style (GM)
global-animation-style.hint: The visual style used when the GM override is enabled.

gm-style-override.name: Force Global Style
gm-style-override.hint: If enabled, all players will see the Global Animation Style instead of their own choice.

critical-color.name: Critical Theme Color
critical-color.hint: The primary glow and bar color for standard critical hits.

critical-size.name: Animation Scale
critical-size.hint: Adjust the size of the animation overlay.

critical-sound.name: Critical Sound Effect
critical-sound.hint: The sound file played during a critical hit. Supports multiple sounds separated by '|' for a random pool.

fumble-sound.name: Fumble Sound Effect
fumble-sound.hint: The sound file played during a fumble (Natural 1). Supports multiple sounds separated by '|' for a random pool.

critical-volume.name: Sound Volume
critical-volume.hint: Adjust the volume of the sound effects.

always-show-crit.name: Always Show Critical Animation
always-show-crit.hint: Force the critical animation on every roll for yourself.

always-show-fumble.name: Always Show Fumble Animation
always-show-fumble.hint: Force the fumble animation on every roll for yourself (if Always Show Critical is off).

user-only.name: User-Only Animations
user-only.hint: If enabled, animations will only appear for the player who made the roll.

ignore-discarded-dice.name: Ignore Discarded Dice
ignore-discarded-dice.hint: If enabled, results on dice discarded by advantage/disadvantage will not trigger animations.

ignore-multi-dice.name: Ignore Large Dice Pools
ignore-multi-dice.hint: If enabled, dice pools with more than 2 d20s (e.g., 10d20) will not trigger automatic animations.
